roles.systems: Systems lead: requirements, NASA compliance, reviews, FDR package
roles.model: Model & science lead: circadian model validation and fitting
roles.software: Software & UI lead: app, data service, Raspberry Pi bring-up, durability tests
roles.hardware: Hardware & CAD lead: printing, wiring, battery, thermal, enclosure changes

milestones.title: Sprint 1: Set up and order parts
Sprint 2: First prints and Pi bring-up

issues.title: Set up the GitHub workflow: branch protection, labels, project board
issues.body: Protect main (PR + 1 review + CI green). Check labels and milestones exist. Make a project board with To do / In progress / Review / Done and add every issue.
done: main is protected
board lists every open issue
all four teammates can push branches

issues.title: Read NASA-STD-3001 Tables 9.3-1, 9.3-2, 10.4-4 and App. F F.5-1; confirm our values
issues.body: The tables are images on nasa.gov, so they were never checked. Get the PDF (standards.nasa.gov), read the corner/edge radius, control spacing and colour tables, and compare with cad/tablet.py Params.
done: table values quoted in 02-requirements.md with the table number
cad/check.py corner and edge checks changed from review to pass or fail
Params changed if a value is short, and checks rerun

issues.title: Get mentor sign-off on deviations DEV-1 and DEV-2
issues.body: DEV-1: crew prompts avoid blue (App. F wants blue advisories). DEV-2: ACK light and night screen are red (App. F ties red to warnings). Present the rationale and mitigations; record the decision.
done: mentor decision recorded in 03-tailoring-matrix.md with date
design changed if the mentor says no

issues.title: Confirm the HIDH sections for touch targets, sleep and lighting
issues.body: Find the Human Integration Design Handbook (NASA/SP-2010-3407) sections and values for touchscreen target size (bare and gloved) and sleep/lighting guidance.
done: section numbers and values in references.md
REQ-UI-003 states a number

issues.title: Build the FDR package and demo script
issues.body: Slides plus the document set. Rehearse the 8 demonstrations in the verification plan on the real tablet.
done: deck reviewed by the whole team
demo run end to end twice without notes
traceability.md regenerated the week of FDR

issues.title: Start a review rota so nobody approves their own work
issues.body: NPR 7150.2 wants independent review. Use the PR template checklist and rotate reviewers each sprint.
done: rota in docs/10-team-plan.md
every merged PR has a reviewer who is not the author

issues.title: Fix the PRC crossover (OI-1)
issues.body: The model's delay-to-advance crossover sits about 1.5 h before CBTmin; target is within 1 h. Replicate a published human PRC protocol in simulation (e.g. Khalsa et al. 2003), compare point by point, and only then adjust CBT_OFF. Check the published constants are transcribed correctly first.
done: REQ-MDL-003 test passes (remove its TODO)
comparison plot in docs/05-model-credibility.md
no other engine test changes

issues.title: Design and run the PVT study to fit readiness weights (OI-2)
issues.body: 1 to 2 weeks, volunteers wear a sleep tracker and do a daily 3-minute PVT (NASA PVT+). Get school or advisor approval and written consent first. Fit the readiness weights and report the fit error.
done: approval and consent forms on file (not in the repo)
anonymised data summary in docs
weights in engine.js with fit error stated
REQ-MDL-004 moves to verified

issues.title: Estimate each crew member's body-clock period (REQ-MDL-005)
issues.body: Add a filter that updates tau and phase from logged sleep and light data. Test on synthetic crew with a known tau.
done: test_REQ_MDL_005 recovers a known tau within 0.1 h
trace.py no longer lists REQ-MDL-005 as missing

issues.title: Sensitivity analysis of model constants
issues.body: Vary each model constant by ±10 % and report how much the plan and predicted readiness change. NASA-STD-7009 robustness factor.
done: table of sensitivities in 05-model-credibility.md
credibility factor updated

issues.title: Make the crew screen usable with gloves
issues.body: At 2x kiosk scale buttons are 11.6 mm. Gloved use needs about 19 mm (confirm in T04). Add a large-target crew layout and check every crew action is also reachable by ACK/SNOOZE.
done: crew buttons measured on the real display
REQ-UI-003 has evidence in 07-verification-plan.md

issues.title: Measure display luminance in each crew mode
issues.body: With the hardware lead: lux meter at a fixed distance, each crew state (alert, neutral, wind-down, sleep) and backlight level.
done: measurements table in 07-verification-plan.md
backlight levels adjusted if wind-down is above target

issues.title: Bring up the real Raspberry Pi 5
issues.body: Fresh Raspberry Pi OS, run setup.sh, check the service and kiosk start on boot with no input, and the 2x scale kiosk looks right on Touch Display 2.
done: boot to crew screen with no keyboard
notes on any setup.sh fixes committed

issues.title: Run the durability tests on the Pi: 10,000 kill-9 cycles and the Pico power-cut rig
issues.body: python3 tools/powercut_harness.py --cycles 10000 on the Pi's SD card, then build the Pico + MOSFET rig (deploy/pico/powercut.py) and run 200 real power cuts.
done: zero lost acknowledged records
results and boot reports in docs

issues.title: Handle a clock reset (fault F-08)
issues.body: If the system clock jumps backwards (dead RTC cell), keep event order from the log sequence and ask the operator to confirm the time.
done: test for F-08
verification plan row marked automated

issues.title: Add coulomb counting to the battery driver (HW-OI-6)
issues.body: Integrate INA260 current between rests; use the voltage curve only at rest. With the hardware lead's runtime log.
done: state-of-charge error under 5 % against the runtime log
unit test with recorded data

issues.title: Order parts and measure the real modules
issues.body: Order the BOM. When parts arrive, measure the Pi + cooler, display (and its mounting holes), boost, BMS, toggles and GX12, and update cad/tablet.py bought() and Params.
done: BOM with prices and links in docs
VERIFY notes removed for measured parts
cad/check.py passes after the update

issues.title: Print test coupons, then the full set
issues.body: Before the 10-hour shell: print the hinge (overlay strip + one cover + pin), a key in its collar, and a teardrop hole. Tune tolerances in Params, then print all parts from cad/out/stl.
done: coupon photos in docs/photos
tolerances updated
every part printed without supports

issues.title: Wire and bench-test the power chain; decide on the charger
issues.body: Cells, BMS, fuse, MAIN, INA260, boost. Test 5 V under a 3 A load before the Pi. Decide: power-path charger, or charge with MAIN off.
done: bench test log
charger decision recorded in 08-hardware-design.md

issues.title: Stop the switch covers drifting and test for pinching
issues.body: Add an O-ring friction washer on the pin or a detent bump that holds the cover closed. Shake test open and closed; finger and glove test the hinge gap.
done: CAD change with checks passing
test results in 07-verification-plan.md

issues.title: Measure mass, temperature and runtime
issues.body: Weigh the built tablet. 10-minute stress-ng run: SoC under 80 °C. Log runtime from full to the low-battery shutdown with the INA260.
done: numbers replace the estimates in 08-hardware-design.md and check.py

issues.title: Battery safety review pack (JSC 20793)
issues.body: Cell datasheets and certificates, BMS limits, fuse rating, enclosure venting, charging procedure. Review with the mentor.
done: review notes in docs
REQ-HW-008 battery check moves from review to pass

issues.title: Build the LED light panel and sensor rig
issues.body: Cool white, warm white and red channels on MOSFETs from the GX12 LIGHT OUT. Feed measured lux from the TSL2591 into the model.
done: lights follow the plan when LIGHTS is on LINK
measured lux appears in the light log
